issues.description: Verified that all 60 achievement locations and requirements across the main story, sidequests, capsule monsters, and Ancient Cave match verified facts with 0 broken citations.
Verified that all 41 roadmap area and boss nodes across 7 chapters are explicitly mentioned and route diagrams correctly reflect progression.
Verified that both missable achievements (Seethru Cape on Tia and Gades in Gordovan Tower) and the Doom Island Point of No Return are warned before their respective deadlines.
Verified 100% cited paragraph coverage with 0 broken citations, 0 QA warnings, and 0 deterministic errors.
